race.description: Celebrate Christmas At Cairns Jockey Club Hcp (Bm55)
race.comment: VINCENTVANGEE (2) is the one to beat after resuming with a second at this track and then breaking through at Townsville, where he overcame tightening near the 400m and still beat Dynamic Legend by a head. The move from Mdn company into a BM55 is the task, but his six-start profile has more upside than most of these. MINNIE VEGAS (6) has been around the mark all campaign, was only beaten a length and a half at Innisfail as a well-supported favourite, and gains Ryan Wiggins for the first time. Key runner. ZIGGY STARCRAFT (1) brings winning Townsville form, having beaten Ceretti by just under a length as favourite, and his distance record is a clear asset. Can give this a shake. GRAND VOILE (8) resumes for Troy Clive after a checked final run at Port Macquarie and her earlier BM58 second at Port Mac gives her the right sort of form for a place. Watch the betting.
